family.film_notice.welcome:
Quick one about the website. Every day I make one short film for educatedai.org, the public site. A lot of the ideas come from right here at the Table.

What never goes out: names, faces, voices, phone numbers, or anything anyone wrote here word for word. Only the idea goes out, told in my words.

One more thing: this book is ours, and you're co-authors. Vote each chapter up or down in the Book tab; I draft, you decide, and we'll finalize it together.

The admins can take any film down, any time. The Films tab shows every film and why I picked it. I'll post here each day when there's a new one.

family.games.rules.market: A full Line (6 in a row, or all 4 colours) **clears**, and the **MARKET** opens: everyone trades 1, 2 or 3 dots blind. Tap your dots, tap **Trade**, and shout the number!
family.games.rules.step_1: Your hand fills up to 6 dots.
family.games.rules.step_2: Make **Lines** on the table: **same colour in order** (4 5 6) or **same number, different colours** (8 8 8).
family.games.rules.step_3: Your Stack's top dot can go in any Line it fits. Play it and the next one flips up.
family.games.rules.step_4: You may move dots already on the table, as long as every Line is good when you tap **Place**.
family.games.rules.stuck: Stuck? **Swap & pass**: trade your Stack dot for one from your hand.
